issues.title: Source imports and runtime library loading: clarify missing-module panic and automation boundary
Investigate filename-dependent TYPE_MISMATCH and BAD_CONVERSION in Prolog source
Document Level B rc integer typing and conversion failures
Clarify that a bare exposed array declaration does not clear existing elements
Investigate reported stale value in Prolog SolveFunctor across returning branches
Explain Level B block scope and NOT_IN_SAME_SCOPE for Classic Rexx migration
Record unreproduced datatype(".", "N") observation and current passing checks
